jei.universal_tool.info.universal_polyme: The Universal Polymerizer arranges base materials and rare cores in a 12-slot ring to forge Universal Tools and arcane devices.
jei.universal_tool.info.operation_phoeni: Fuel the Phoenix Pod with a DNA Sample and Nutrient Solution to clone a backup vessel that rescues you from fatal damage.
jei.universal_tool.info.personal_space_g: The Pocket Realm Gate lets players switch freely among all 8 traited 512x512 realms, or open the secondary menu to enter their UUID-bound 25x25x25 Private Starry Space (Shift-right-click starry blocks to return).
jei.universal_tool.info.klein_bottle: The Klein Bottle houses an infinite Klein Terminal with a built-in crafting table, hyper smelter, and anvil; Shift-right-click containers to absorb items.
jei.universal_tool.info.universal_lotter: The Universal Lottery Machine offers Void Dice, Roulette, and Slot Machine modes (Shift-right-click empty-handed to cycle), scaling rewards by item value.
jei.universal_tool.info.universal_repair: Universal Repair Material restores full durability to damaged gear in the Universal Polymerizer or an anvil.
jei.universal_tool.info.teleport_codex: The Teleport Codex captures snapshots and records cross-dimensional waypoints for instant warping or transcribing into Teleport Scrolls.
